ai-data / Collection

Apify

Reusable data jobs connected to business workflows.

AOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Run reusable collection and processing jobs called Actors through Apify's platform, API, and datasets. MoreSpace can build approved public-web research pipelines, scheduled source monitoring, and custom data-processing jobs with a clear input schema and monitored outputs. We select or develop an appropriate Actor, validate its field quality and source permissions, and connect accepted records to an analyst or operations workspace.

Useful outputs

  • A dataset with source context
  • Run status and exception records
  • Accepted data ready for analysis

Where we can apply it

  • Approved source list → Actor run → validation and deduplication → research dataset.
  • Public catalog watchlist → scheduled jobs → change review → analyst alert queue.
  • Authorized data-processing request → custom Actor → monitored dataset → internal dashboard.
01

Use case 1

Collect agreed public company or catalog fields into a dataset.

02

Use case 2

Schedule source monitoring with visible job status and exceptions.

03

Use case 3

Build a custom Actor for a defined data-processing requirement.

Inputs we need

  • Approved URLs or processing inputs
  • An Actor input schema
  • Cadence and record-validation rules

Delivery sequence

  • Select or develop an Actor for the permitted source and agreed fields.
  • Run the job manually or through a schedule or authorized API trigger.
  • Validate and deduplicate results before routing accepted records downstream.

Expert review points

  • Inspect source access and third-party Actor behavior before production use.
  • Sample output accuracy and maintain retries, limits, and failure alerts.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • n8n
  • Google BigQuery
  • Retool
  • Custom APIs

Signals we can make visible

  • Actor run success rate
  • Record acceptance rate
  • Duplicate record rate
  • Dataset freshness

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
